world.topic: Fit a straight line y = a + b x to the 40 points in `/initial-state/inputs/0/points.csv` by ordinary least squares. Report a and b with 95% confidence intervals and the residual standard deviation, make one figure (the points, the fitted line and its 95% confidence band), and write a one-page report `report/report.md` (Markdown is enough) with the numbers, the figure and the analysis code used. This is a small task: a few minutes of work on one CPU.
